stem_book: The number of solutions of the equation 12cos^(3)x − 7cos^(2)x + 4cos x − 9 = 0 is (a) 0 (b) 2 (c) infinity (d) None
reason: Manifest wrote cos³x, cos²x as 'cos 3 x', 'cos 2 x'; stem rewritten. No interval printed, so x ∈ ℝ.
work: (cos x − 1)(12cos²x + 5cos x + 9) = 0, quadratic disc 25 − 432 < 0 ⇒ cos x = 1 ⇒ x = 2nπ ⇒ infinitely many
